description.value: Zuna Adventures is a First Nations-owned fishing charter company based in Campbell River, BC, proudly operated by members of the Ligwilda'xw people of the Kwakwaka'wakw nation. Captain Gary Johnson leads guided salmon fishing, bottom fishing, crabbing, fly fishing, and cultural tours aboard the Zuna, a Hewescraft Ocean Pro 240 with capacity for up to 5 guests. Campbell River, known as the Salmon Capital of the World, is the backdrop for these small-group coastal adventures rooted in generations of local water knowledge.
